notes: Channel aliases only. Each entry maps to a real engine/registry.json preset, camera, transition, background or component. Plans write the registry name in the slot plus these params; alias names are NOT valid in animation.json.
An element has one enter ('preset'), one 'loop' and one 'exit'; they share ONE params object with the component params. Merge, e.g. snip_in + snip_out -> {"inSec":0.28,"overshoot":0.08,"outSec":0.2}.
pop_in overshoot: 0.06 subtle, 0.10 clear, 0.14 channel maximum.
Cameras ease across the whole scene and reset at the next scene. Text layers scale with the camera (no screen-space layer), so pushes stay small.
Carry-forward: elements do not persist across scenes. Redeclare the chip, disclaimer and existing props in every scene with preset 'none' (hold_static).
Sizes: Shape width/height and Prop/Character width are fractions of video width; fontSize/strokeWidth are px at 1080w.

snip_in.use: Default enter for props and Inch pose-first appearance.

tag_slap.use: Badges (check/cross), stamps, stat callouts, step slates, TRY IT TODAY note, disclaimer tag first appearance.

card_in.use: cite_card and its text lines (stagger text +0.15 s each).

rise.use: Chart bars growing, jar fill coins, stacking.

slide_left.use: Inch or a prop entering from the left.

slide_right.use: Inch or a prop entering from the right.

nope_jolt.use: Prop/Inch on the problem word. Redeclare the element with this preset in the problem beat.

soft_on.use: Glows, night overlays, the caveat line. Not for props.

hold_static.use: Carry-forward of chip, disclaimer, earlier props; loop-frame redeclare.

coin_bob.use: A single hero coin or the lightbulb. Max 1 per beat.

soft_pulse.use: Stat callout or glow while it is being spoken.

alert_pulse.use: cross_coral or notification_dot while the problem is unsolved.

snip_out.use: Removing a cross badge or a replaced prop.

quiet_out.use: Cite card, glows and tags at the end of their beat. Never on the final scene.

cam_hold.use: Default; at least 60% of beats, always on cite-card and loop beats.

cam_lean_in.use: Land on the fix prop (named object = last word of the sentence).

cam_land.use: One per video max: the try-it-today beat or the big stat.

cam_slide_r.use: Attention moves right (target stays left of x 0.82).

cam_rise.use: Attention moves up (growing bars, stacked coins).

beat_cut.use: Default between beats and into the loop frame.

time_skip.use: Time jumps: day 1 to day 30, night to morning, 'ten years later'.

page_turn.use: Only into the cite card beat. Max 1 per video.

caption_main.use: One Caption per script segment, timed to the segment.

chip_back.use: Persistent pillar chip backing, every scene from frame 0.

chip_dot.use: Pillar dot: Money #3FA37A, Mind #7FB3D5, Body #F2B632, Ready #C9A77C. Coral is never a pillar colour.

disclaimer_back.use: From the cite card to the end (Money/Body/Ready). hold_static after its first scene.

disclaimer_text.use: 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE' / 'NOT MEDICAL ADVICE' / 'FOLLOW LOCAL GUIDANCE'.

cite_card.use: Hold 2.5-3.5 s. All four text styles below share rotation -2.

cite_tab_text.use: 'THE STUDY' / 'THE DATA' / 'MY NUMBERS'. Adjust x/y to the drawn tab.

cite_source_text.use: '[Author] et al., [Year]' or '[Agency], [Year]'. Values from idea.md only.

cite_finding_text.use: One number or a 2-4 word finding. For text findings use color #26303F, strokeWidth 0, fontSize 72.

cite_limit_text.use: 'Limit: n = [N]' / 'self-reported' / 'correlation, not cause' / 'illustrative math'. Pair with cite_limit_dot.

cite_limit_dot.use: Coral dot before the limit line; adjust x to the text start.

step_slate.use: Numbered step. 1.5-2.5 s, then the acting beat.

step_label.use: 2-4 word step name. Enters 0.15 s after the numeral.

stat_callout.use: Number + unit ('$1,825/YR'). Sourced or labelled illustrative. A count-up is FUTURE; step through 2-3 values across beats instead.

fix_counter.use: 'FIX n/7' in 7 Fixes Later only. Re-enter on change; otherwise hold_static.

try_today_note.use: Final beat. SFX stamp_thud at the enter frame. Action text stays in the caption.

do_confetti.use: On the final check or try-it-today only. Unique seed per element.

problem_specks.use: Abstract waste/loss (money leaking, distractions). Unique seed.

host.use: Inch. Tune y so the foot baseline sits on the floor line (0.64) for the drawn canvas; then never change it within a video. Poses via params.poses [{atSec, asset}].
